description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the MyInfoAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM API plugin. It tests various API endpoints and behaviors, including fetching and updating personal information, although update/delete methods are not implemented.

classes.name: MyInfoAPITest
classes.description: Test class for the MyInfoAPI endpoint, verifying getOne functionality and ensuring unimplemented methods throw exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Runs a test to fetch a single 'My Info' record using provided test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for 'testGetOne' method from YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that calling update() on MyInfoAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that getValidationRuleForUpdate() on MyInfoAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that delete() on MyInfoAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that getValidationRuleForDelete() on MyInfoAPI throws a not implemented exception.
